subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements:

1. Parliament can bar the jurisdiction of courts over inter-state water disputes.

2. Article 262 empowers the Inter-State Council to adjudicate water disputes.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1:** Parliament can bar the jurisdiction of courts over inter-state water disputes.

 
 
• **Article 262** of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to exclude the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court or any other court in matters related to inter-state water disputes.
 
• The Parliament can enact laws under Article 262 to resolve inter-state river disputes. For example, the **Inter-State River Water Disputes Act (1956)** was enacted to address such disputes.
 
• This provision ensures that inter-state water disputes are adjudicated by specially constituted tribunals rather than courts, promoting quicker resolution. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
 
 
• **Statement 2:** Article 262 empowers the Inter-State Council to adjudicate water disputes.
 
 
• This statement is incorrect as **Article 262** does not empower the Inter-State Council to adjudicate water disputes.
